# Fisher Scientific Canada

> > Fisher Scientific Canada is a comprehensive lab supplies and research equipment platform offering procurement services, loyalty programs, and specialized solutions for laboratories and production facilities.

Fisher Scientific Canada (fishersci.ca) serves as the primary e-commerce and information hub for laboratory supplies, research equipment, and production essentials across Canada. The site integrates procurement services, sustainability initiatives, and specialized programs for diverse customer segments including academic institutions, government agencies, and manufacturing facilities.

## Key Topics

- Lab supplies
- Research equipment
- Procurement services
